questions.stem: A 30-year-old man presents with complaints of persistent nasal obstruction due to chronic rhinitis. He reports frequent dryness in his nose and mouth, morning headaches, and excessive daytime sleepiness. Overnight pulse oximetry shows episodic oxygen desaturation and elevated CO₂ levels. Which of the following best explains the physiological consequence of his chronic nasal obstruction?
questions.stemHtml: A 30-year-old man presents with complaints of persistent nasal obstruction due to chronic rhinitis. He reports frequent dryness in his nose and mouth, morning headaches, and excessive daytime sleepiness. Overnight pulse oximetry shows episodic oxygen desaturation and elevated CO₂ levels. Which of the following best explains the physiological consequence of his chronic nasal obstruction?

options.label: A
options.text: Reduced vibrissae function leading to allergic sensitization

options.label: B
options.text: Loss of nasal humidification impairing ciliary function and increasing airway infection risk

options.label: C
options.text: Cooling of inspired air causing bronchial hyperreactivity

options.label: D
options.text: Reduced mucus production triggering olfactory nerve dysfunction
